purpose: Output quality on a dirty fixture. Each scenario starts from a fresh copy of evals/fixture with one commit, runs a fresh agent with only the skill loaded, then runs check_behavioral.sh.
setup: cp -r evals/fixture/. <workdir> && git -C <workdir> init -q && git -C <workdir> add -A && git -C <workdir> commit -qm fixture
how_to_run: For each scenario: create <workdir>, run the setup, give the prompt to an agent with the skill path, then run the scenario check. Compare with a baseline run that has no skill.

evals.prompt: Audit this repo's AGENTS.md and fix it. Keep the test command working.
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md no longer contains the planted token, the dead lint script, or the known-bug caveat. The bug is recorded in TODO_BEFORE_SHIPPING.md with its trigger and fix, src/calc.py stays untouched, the generated file is marked with its regeneration command, the test command is kept, and the file is 80 lines or fewer.
assertions: AGENTS.md contains no ghp_ token and no API_TOKEN line
AGENTS.md does not contain a known-bug caveat or ZeroDivisionError
TODO_BEFORE_SHIPPING.md names average, the empty input trigger, and ZeroDivisionError
src/calc.py and src/zz_generated_ids.py are unchanged from the fixture commit
AGENTS.md names src/zz_generated_ids.py, marks it generated, and names bash scripts/gen.sh
AGENTS.md keeps a python3 -m unittest command and it passes

evals.prompt: Add one line to AGENTS.md: run the tests with -v.
evals.expected_output: One added line in AGENTS.md and nothing else. No TODO_BEFORE_SHIPPING.md, no audit, no recon, and the planted token and bug stay untouched.
assertions: git diff shows exactly 1 added line and 0 deleted lines for AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md is the only changed file
The existing API_TOKEN line is still present
